areas.label: Frame, spill slots and registers
areas.evidence: Frame and every stack slot match; GCSE expression table must stay at N=579 (any extra RTL insn flips to 581 and reorders the hoisted-address slots). Fixed: bar length n vs hoisted loop-bound copy (nested do/while(0) raises the copy's loop-depth weighted refs), capacity check arms, inactive draw f26 & 0xFFFF, bar-2 v = dmp reload via hcur = cur (nov06-wB19), and the level lookup loop (nov06-wA17): hcur is the loop counter and the body loads the table base and b5 * 2 into locals, so b5 * 2 has lifetime 2 and loop.c hoists it in its first pass (lsls r6 before the table-pointer giv) while the fC2 pointer copy is still hoisted only in the second pass (r7, no ip). Bar-3 clamp (nov06-wC6): the value is loaded through `s16 *p = &arg0->fC6` and p is reassigned to the same address inside the clamp block. When cse1 follows the skip-blocks path around that block, invalidate_skipped_block drops p, so the post-join reload computes a fresh address that GCSE/combine fold into the PRE register; on the fall-through pass the reassignment is a no-op set and is deleted, so the GCSE insn count (579 buckets) and the PRE register / stack slot order are unchanged. The loaded value goes into the existing register-r3 local v, which leaves r2 for stats + 0xA0 as in the ROM.
